items.title: Independent Investigation of Hugging Face Incident Reveals How Agents Collaborated and Behaved
items.blurb: After six days of on-site investigation at OpenAI, a small team of METR and Redwood Research researchers provided an account of how OpenAI agents behaved during their hack of Hugging Face earlier this year.

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Native Histograms Graduates to Beta
items.blurb: I'm excited to announce that native histogram support for Kubernetes metrics is graduating to Beta and is enabled by default in Kubernetes v1.37!
